## How this site works

::: {.principles}
:::: {}
### Test before trusting
Every workflow is run on a real research task before it is published, and says how to check what the model produced.
::::
:::: {}
### Date everything
Models change every few months. Each page records the model, the tool and the date of the last test.
::::
:::: {}
### Publish the failures
Where a model got it wrong, the page says so. The [Failures](failures/index.qmd) section collects the errors worth knowing about.
::::
:::: {}
### Keep it open
Text is CC BY 4.0, code is MIT, and anyone can propose a workflow through GitHub. See [Contribute](contribute.qmd).
::::
:::
